name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A rulebook and command set that stops AI-built websites from all looking like the same generic SaaS template.
buyer: A freelance developer or small agency shipping client websites built mostly by AI, who needs them to not look AI-generated.
business_use_cases: A solo-founder agency uses it to polish AI-built MVPs before client demos, winning repeat business.
A no-code/low-code shop runs the detector rules as a QA gate before every client delivery.
A freelancer sells a 'design audit' pass on an existing AI-built site to fix the tell-tale generic look.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a flat-fee 'de-genericize your AI website' audit and fix package to small businesses.
Offer an ongoing design QA subscription for agencies shipping multiple AI-built sites per month.

steal_this: This weekend, package the CLI's audit output into a branded PDF report and sell it as a $99 'does your site look AI-made?' check to small business owners.
